## LEARNINGS

- Elite 2 (4-expert sparse top-1 MoE, 6 attn layers) already near-dominates elites 0/1 at ~equal FLOPs with much better loss (3.965 vs 4.155/4.097) — top_k over only 2 experts (elites 0/1) wastes the sparsity lever; wider sparse MoE (4-8 experts, k=1) is the efficient direction, not more attention layers, for the cheap end.
- Elite 3 (8 attn + 8-expert MoE, 0.121G/3.935) vs elite 2 (6 attn + 4-expert MoE, 0.092G/3.965) suggests attention depth is expensive relative to expert-count for loss gains — worth testing 6-attn-layer bases with elite3's full 8-expert MoE grafted on to try to dominate both.
- The dense attention-only elites (4,5) hold the loss frontier but pay heavily in FLOPs with zero gating — spare capacity there is a prime target for splicing in sparse MoE (mid-stack or tail) to cut FLOPs without losing loss, and for grafting bigger MoE tails to push loss even lower.
- No elite has used concat/gather/scatter_add or cross-block/router-reuse wiring yet — clear novelty budget still unspent; also worth testing a fully attention-free causal mean-mixer as a structurally distinct, cheap lineage.
